allowed_consumer_inputs: the listed Contract-B base64 part files

contract_b_input.concatenation_rule: read parts in lexical order, strip trailing newline from each, concatenate, then base64-decode
contract_b_input.note: The decoded ZIP is a neutral deterministic transport wrapper. Validate extracted Contract-B SHA256SUMS, bundle identity and bundle hash.

forbidden_consumer_inputs: Apparatus PR #13 implementation files, tests, workflow code, comments, field-source map, field-justification registry, ablation matrix, weak-candidate controls, producer-boundary capture, semantic-firewall results, telemetry-invariance results, or summary.json
CAL RC2-C / RC2-D implementation or evaluator internals
Claim Audit Lab production implementation or traces beyond bytes present in this handoff
expected Consumer B outputs or producer-side reasoning about how the candidate should be consumed
non_claims: not a Contract-C version or production schema
purpose: Durably hand the exact frozen Contract-C RC2 producer candidate and its bound Contract-B input to a later independent Consumer B experiment without producer implementation or producer-side reasoning.
